Inoculants
Inoculants are a powder that contain beneficial bacteria. When mixed with soya bean seeds before planting, these bacteria help the roots to capture nitrogen (N) from the air so that the plants can grow better. When using inoculants with your soya, you get better soya bean yields and you do not need to use nitrogen (N) fertilisers (Urea, CAN, SA) on your soya beans.
